credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Sketch of an abstract landscape in graphite. Simple line drawing, no shading. Large hill formations on right side of paper in foreground. Smaller hill formation on left side of paper in background. Horizon line is drawn in background level with the top of the small hill formation on the left.
title: Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)
